summary: Iteration 4 (precision 0.001g + drops/tetes converter + IDR currency) fully verified: backend 28/28 pytest PASS (9 new feature tests + 19 regression), frontend 36/36 checks PASS across 4 Playwright runs. PRECISION: weight inputs accept 3 decimals (Bergamot 1.375 -> live 14.7% of formula, header '9.375 g total'), dashboard shows '9.000 g concentrate', builder header '9.000 g total', lab sheet rows X.XXX g, calculator 18.000/82.000/100.000 g. DROPS: per-row g/drops toggle works - Bergamot 1g -> 20 drops with hint '= 1.000 g · 0.05 g/drop'; typing 30 drops -> 1.5g and live 15.8%; toggling back shows 1.5; Ambroxan custom factor 0.045 -> 33.3 drops with hint '= 1.500 g · 0.045 g/drop'; picker list shows each material's g/drop factor + IDR price. DROPS BACKEND: POST /api/ingredients accepts/persists dropWeightGrams (custom 0.033 verified via GET), defaults to 0.05, rejects 0 and >1 with 422; all 5 seeded materials return correct factors (Ambroxan 0.045). IDR: seed migration confirmed (Bergamot 12500/g etc.); cards show 'Rp 12.500,00/g'; add-material modal labeled 'Cost / gram (Rp)'; UI-created material TEST_UI_Sandalwood (8750/g, 0.062 g/drop) persists and renders 'Rp 8.750,00/g' + '0.062 g/drop' on card; calculator HPP 'Rp 104.800,00' (18g x 52400/9, mathematically exact); lab sheet HPP 'Rp 52.400,00'; settings currency 'IDR (Rp)'. CSV EXPORT: downloads velvet-cedar-lab-sheet.csv with Drops column, Cost (IDR) column with Rp-formatted values, and 'HPP (raw material cost),"Rp 52.400,00"' total line (full content verified). REGRESSION: login, IFRA red alert on Bergamot (2.00% vs 0.40%), draft caching banner (edit -> reload -> banner -> restore 2 -> discard -> back to 1) all PASS. No new bugs found.

critical_code_review_comments: src/format.ts is a clean single source of truth: formatGrams (toFixed(3)), formatIDR ('.' thousands / ',' decimals), dropsToGrams (mg-rounded), gramsToDrops (tenths). All screens/exports consume it consistently - no drift found.
Drops unit toggle is correctly UI-local state (unitByItem); stored weightGrams always stays grams - verified by toggling 30 drops -> 1.5g -> back to g shows 1.5.

Backend seed migration (server.py:182-194) is idempotent: only upgrades legacy USD-scale costs (<100) and backfills missing dropWeightGrams; re-runs are safe. Ambroxan=0.045 custom factor seeded correctly.
CSV export (labsheet.ts) properly csv-escapes Rp values containing commas; HPP total line matches spec exactly.
Note: calculator 'Rp 4.712,00' in the request was a format example only; actual 100g@18% Velvet Cedar cost is Rp 104.800,00 (18g x weighted avg 5822.22/g) - verified exact.
Two test-check false negatives during the run were my own case-sensitive innerText checks vs CSS text-transform:uppercase labels; re-verified case-insensitively as PASS. Not app bugs.
